units.source_text: 离洞上面边缘一米左右的地方，一道淡淡的光，浮起了个环。

en.t: About a meter below the upper edge of the hole, a faint light had risen in a ring.

units.source_text: 预计大约六点半以后得过了四十分钟了吧。

en.t: Probably about forty minutes had passed since six thirty.
Now was just the right time.

units.source_text: 他把两臂向后猛拉，把头转了几圈，松了松肩膀上的肌肉。

en.t: He jerked both arms backward, rolled his head several times, and loosened the muscles in his shoulders.
